title: marked: locate why two headings can end up with the same id
prompt: In this copy of marked 4.3.0, heading ids are no longer always unique: the document `# Intro`, `# Intro`, `# Intro 1` renders ids `intro`, `intro-1`, `intro-1`, so anchor links hit the wrong heading (earlier versions produced `intro-1-1` for the third). Trace how heading ids are generated from the parser down to where they are stored, find the root cause and fix it with a minimal change.
